task_input: Harden verifyPlanRevisionOutput in core/scripts/verify-harness-commits.ts. A model may emit `## Feedback Incorporated`, then a fenced block which repeats that heading before its tagged acknowledgement bullets. Treat that shape as a valid acknowledgement when the fenced section contains `[ADDRESSED]` or `[DEFERRED]` bullets; keep missing or untagged acknowledgements blocked. Add focused regression tests.

implementing.plan: Normalize fence delimiters before locating acknowledgement headings, tolerate duplicate headings without truncating the tagged items, preserve the fail-closed missing/untagged behavior, and add direct parser regression tests.

hidden_checks: node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { verifyPlanRevisionOutput } from "./core/scripts/verify-harness-commits.ts"; const output=["## Feedback Incorporated","```","## Feedback Incorporated","- [ADDRESSED] Corrected the validation","```","","## Revised Plan"].join("\n"); assert.deepEqual(verifyPlanRevisionOutput(output),{ok:true});'

acceptance_criteria.statement: A duplicated acknowledgement heading inside a fence does not hide a valid tagged acknowledgement bullet.
